// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 120000, "max_output_tokens": 800}
const r=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({transparent_background:true,prompt:"Production ANIMATED CONTACT EFFECT pixel-art sprite atlas for a Chinese myth side-view action game. Exactly SIX columns by FOUR rows =24 separated cells on genuinely transparent RGBA, equal cells and generous empty gutters. Each set of THREE adjacent cells is the SAME impact over time: first contact tiny sharp flash, second compact material burst, third sparse dissipating fragments. Two 3-frame sets per row. Row1 left set STEEL: tiny warm-white directional slash contact, short copper sparks, no magic circle; row1 right STONE: compact dusty amber crack, 3-5 angular stone chips, earth weight. Row2 left INK/CHAIN: violet-black brush blot and a few broken bronze link flecks; row2 right VENOM: small acid-jade spatter droplets with dark olive edges, no poison skull. Row3 left WATER: bright cyan-white droplet splash with foam flecks, clearly liquid; row3 right THUNDER: thin blue-white forked contact crown, 2-3 jagged sparks, no huge lightning column. Row4 left FIRE: compact vermilion-gold ember snap, 3 curled short flames, no smoke cloud; row4 right WIND: pale celadon-white curved pressure whisk and a few airy short streaks, mostly empty transparent space. Effects will be 20-40 world pixels in game: use LARGE readable pixel clusters, crisp material silhouettes, small bright centres, restrained shading, no glow haze, no giant filled discs, no translucent rectangular matte, no scenery, text, characters, weapons, grids or labels. Keep all24 frames isolated inside their own cells. Contact hotspot at centre, each burst stays small, grounded, tactile rather than icon-like. No complete circular magic runes or generic purple ovals. All effects consistent pixel density."});store("enemy_contact",r);generatedImage(r);text({hint:r.output_hint});

// @exec: {"yield_time_ms": 120000, "max_output_tokens": 800}
const r=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({transparent_background:true,prompt:"Create a production material sprite atlas for enemy attacks in a Chinese mythology side-scrolling PIXEL game. EXACT 4 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS, 16 completely isolated full assets, generous transparent gutters, no overlap. Genuine transparent RGBA, NO backdrop or haze, no text, labels or grid. Large clean pixel clusters and restrained highlights; visually tactile, not UI icons. These are modular materials rendered at native 12-48px size and REPEATED for larger areas, never blown up into huge rectangles. Row1 left to right: a thin ancient wood/bronze CROSSBOW BOLT flying RIGHT with a pointed head and short pale wind whisk; a single narrow vertical BRONZE CHAIN LINK segment with dark violet metal and crisp holes; a small acid-JADE VENOM PEARL flying RIGHT with dark green rim and bright droplet core; a small red-gold FIRE WHEEL with visibly burning rim, transparent open centre, no logo or magic rune. Row2: low right-moving cyan-green WAVE CREST, a white-cyan FOAM BASE splash expanding sideways, a foaming WATER SPOUT CROWN, a thin irregular vertical cyan WATER SHAFT SEGMENT suitable for repeating vertically. Row3: small violet INK-SEAL ground smudge with brush-like edges and a narrow split, a small antique-gold geometric TOWER SEAL ground plate with no writing, a low amber STONE CRACK on the ground with two tiny chips, sparse small neutral STONE DUST fragments. Row4: narrow blue-white LIGHTNING FORK with two short branches, a narrow warm-gold TOWER BEAM segment with subtle dark-gold side rails and clear bright centre, an airy pale-celadon WIND RIBBON moving RIGHT, a thin warm-white STEEL CUT crescent open to the left. No generic purple ovals, filled circular spell disks, enormous bloom or painterly fog. Preserve all shapes entirely within each equal cell; orient horizontal projectiles toward RIGHT and vertical segments straight up. No characters or weapon-holding hands."});store("enemy_material",r);generatedImage(r);text({hint:r.output_hint});
